en.title: Continue the Snow Temple yard chapter to Lu Qian
en.body: The Android example can now play through both fodder-yard parties, open the temple gate and enter Lu Qian’s encounter. Both hosts follow the original chapter rules for movement, health and learned techniques.

zh.title: 草料场清场后可穿过院门迎战陆谦
zh.body: Android 章节示例现可接连打完草料场两队敌人，穿过开启的院门，与陆谦会面并交战。两个宿主均沿用原作的移动、血量和招式规则。
